ValidationRule.description: This will not allow the confirm spa quick action to change from Sent/Failed to Send TO Sending Status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( QCC_Spa_Request_Outcome__c ), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(QCC_Spa_Request_Outcome__c), 'Pending'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(QCC_Spa_Request_Outcome__c , 'Sending')) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(QCC_Spa_Request_Outcome__c), 'Failed to Send'), ISPICKVAL(QCC_Spa_Request_Outcome__c , 'Sent') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(QCC_Spa_Request_Outcome__c), 'Sent'), ISPICKVAL(QCC_Spa_Request_Outcome__c , 'Failed to Send') ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Changing to this Spa Request Outcome is not allowed. Please set to Pending first.
